name: Devil in Disguise

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: Embracing your devilish nature, you've grown accustomed to changing your appearance to deceive others. If you are Doomed when you assemble a disguise to impersonate, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception checks to interact with someone while disguised and to the DC for observers to detect your disguise. Additionally, you can cast 3rd-rank Illusory Disguise as a divine innate spell once per day.
